1.descricao: Go to the desk indicated in your booking and locate the QR Code displayed there.

2.descricao: Click start scanning and allow access to the device's camera.

3.descricao: Keep the code framed in the scan area for a few seconds.

4.descricao: The system validates the booking and automatically confirms your arrival.

camera.validacaoReservaTexto: Check-in will only be accepted at the correct desk and within the allowed time window.
camera.utilizeCamaraOuImagem: Use the camera or select an image.
camera.semReservaTexto: Check your bookings or book a space to check in.
camera.aponteCamara: Point the camera at the desk's QR Code.
camera.navegadorVaiPedirAutorizacao: The browser will ask for your permission.
camera.qrLidoAValidar: QR Code scanned successfully. Validating your booking...
camera.mantenhaQrEnquadrado: Keep the QR Code framed within the marker. Detection is automatic.
camera.camaraApenasDuranteLeitura: The camera will only be used while scanning.
camera.qrInvalidoAviso: This code isn't a SpaceHub check-in QR Code. Make sure you're scanning the code displayed at the correct desk.
